«مع قوله عليه السلام» names no transmitter before the Imam, and no previous report is supplied: no chain (rule 10)
«وَ مَعَ قَوْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» gives a saying with no transmitter and no name for the speaker; no previous report in the context supplies one, so there is no chain to read (rule 10)
